note: Headline claims for the article's evidence chips. Values are read from the source files by build_claims.py. Nothing here is measured. 'fidelity' is one of simulated | RTL | designed | measured. notebook_cell / pytest are filled when the verify notebook (M6) exists; until then status is pending-verify. Article claims (ids not starting p1./arena. at first) were added by the M5 writer; a claim may carry source.regex or source.derive (see scripts/check_article_numbers.py), display_scale and display_abs. Re-running build_claims.py would overwrite them.

schema_fields.id: stable claim id shown in the chip
